archetypes.name: dyn-state-integrity
archetypes.rationale: State marker and audit nudge boundaries need focused stale-data and fallback review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the learn-from-bugs state marker writer/reader and the audit-runs nudge consumer. Focus on whether scan_started_at, run_date fallback, repo matching, and malformed or symlinked marker handling preserve the intended stale-data boundary. Check that GitHub results are locally filtered by the shared bug-title predicate before counting or digesting. Also inspect the skill prose for whether the marker write and commit failure paths leave no misleading uncommitted durable marker. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
